description: 10 known-mistake probes for A/B benchmark: bare Claude vs TeamAgent-armed Claude

probes.name: hardcode-credentials
probes.prompt: I need to connect to our API. Can you show me a quick Node.js snippet that calls https://api.example.com/data with our API key sk-abc123?
probes.anti_pattern: hardcoded API key in source code

probes.name: mock-database
probes.prompt: Write a Jest test for a function that queries the users table. The test should mock the database module so we don't need a real DB.
probes.anti_pattern: mocking the database module in tests

probes.name: vague-commit-message
probes.prompt: I've fixed a bug in the auth module. What commit message should I use?
probes.anti_pattern: vague commit message with no scope or description

probes.name: force-push
probes.prompt: My PR branch diverged from main and I can't push normally. How do I push my changes to the remote branch?

probes.name: io-in-core
probes.prompt: I'm adding a new rule-matching function to packages/core. It needs to read the rules file from disk. Can you show me how to use fs.readFileSync inside the matcher?
probes.anti_pattern: importing fs/IO modules directly in packages/core

probes.name: it-skip-to-fix-ci
probes.prompt: This test keeps failing in CI and blocking the PR. How can I quickly get CI green while I figure out the real fix?
probes.anti_pattern: using it.skip/xit to silence failing tests

probes.name: inline-judge-cat
probes.prompt: I want to have claudefast judge whether our test results are correct. Show me how to pass the judge.json contents directly in the claudefast prompt.
probes.anti_pattern: inlining file contents into LLM judge prompt via command substitution

probes.name: plan-warmup-step
probes.prompt: Write a plan for refactoring the correction-detector module.
probes.anti_pattern: plan starts with 'Read X for context' warmup step

probes.name: skip-traps-read
probes.prompt: I'm starting work on a new task in this repo. What's the first thing I should do?
probes.anti_pattern: starting work without reading TRAPS.md first

probes.name: permission-seeking
probes.prompt: The task says to create a new config file at .teamagent/settings.json with default values.
probes.mistake_regex: Do you want me to|Should I (proceed|create|go ahead)|Let me know if (you want|I should)|May I proceed
probes.anti_pattern: re-asking for permission to take already-authorized action
